From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Garden Spotlight — co-host webinar idea + quick sync

Hi Lena,

Hope things are going well at Garden Labs. We really enjoyed your product update last quarter — lots of resonance with our field teams. I wanted to propose a short, co-hosted webinar called "Garden Spotlight: Building Reliable Retrieval Apps" where we do a technical 30-min demo + 15 min customer use-case (could be a joint case study).

High-level ask:
- Redwood provides a short runtime demo and a short ops checklist (15 minutes)
- Garden Labs provides a customer case study + product demo (15 minutes)
- Joint promo: 2 weeks of email + 1 blog swap + social posts

Possible windows: Nov 30–Dec 10 (US morning) or Dec 14–18. Do either of those ranges work for you? If yes, can you share a point person on your side for scheduling and a headshot we can use for promo?

I attached a one-pager to illustrate the format and typical audience. If this looks interesting I can loop in our alliances PM to draft a mutual action plan.

Thanks — excited about this.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen | Head of Alliances 
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Garden Spotlight — co-host webinar idea + quick sync

Stephanie — love this. Thanks for the clear ask. Nov 30–Dec 10 works for our calendar team; prefer first week of December.

I'll be the program lead and Tom will handle the product demo. I'll send headshots and a slide template by end of week. High level we can commit to:
- 30m technical / 15m customer use-case (we have a customer who might join: Branch & Bloom)
- Promo: Garden will cross-post to our newsletter and run 1 social campaign

Quick Q: do you have an AV checklist for recording live vs. pre-recording? Also, we need an internal budget note for a small speaker stipend — any precedent there?

I'll pause on dates until we sync with Redwood's PM to lock the exact day/time.

—Lena
